description: Tavuk Sis, a beloved Turkish classic, features succulent chicken pieces marinated in a rich blend of yogurt, olive oil, and aromatic spices, then grilled to perfection on skewers. This recipe delivers incredibly juicy and flavorful chicken that is a staple at any Turkish barbecue or family meal. Enjoy the authentic taste of Turkey with every tender bite of these irresistible chicken skewers.

ingredients.item: Boneless, skinless chicken breast or thigh

ingredients.notes: if using wooden, soak in water for 30 minutes

instructions.title: Prepare the Chicken
instructions.text: Cut the chicken breast or thigh into uniform 1.5-inch cubes. Ensure the pieces are roughly the same size for even cooking. Place the chicken cubes in a large bowl.

instructions.title: Make the Marinade
instructions.text: In a separate bowl, whisk together the plain yogurt, olive oil, minced garlic, tomato paste, sweet paprika, dried oregano, cumin, salt, black pepper, and lemon juice until well combined. This creates the signature tangy and savory Turkish marinade.

instructions.title: Marinate the Chicken
instructions.text: Pour the prepared marinade over the chicken cubes in the large bowl. Toss the chicken thoroughly to ensure every piece is evenly coated. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or preferably overnight, for maximum flavor penetration and tenderness.

instructions.title: Prepare Skewers
instructions.text: If using wooden skewers, soak them in water for at least 30 minutes to prevent burning on the grill. Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece to allow for even cooking.

instructions.title: Preheat Grill or Oven
instructions.text: Preheat your grill to medium-high heat (around 400F/200C) or preheat your oven to 400F (200C) if baking. If grilling, lightly oil the grates to prevent sticking. If baking, line a baking sheet with foil and place a wire rack on top.

instructions.title: Cook the Skewers
instructions.text: Grill the chicken skewers for 15-20 minutes, turning every 4-5 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through, lightly charred, and reaches an internal temperature of 165F (74C). If baking, cook for 20-30 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden brown and cooked through. Serve immediately.

tips: For extra tender chicken, ensure you marinate for at least 4 hours, or ideally overnight. The yogurt acts as a tenderizer.
Do not overcrowd the skewers; leave a small gap between chicken pieces to allow for even cooking and proper charring.
Serve Tavuk Sis with traditional Turkish sides like pilaf, cacik (cucumber yogurt dip), grilled vegetables, and fresh lavash bread for a complete meal.
article:
Turkish cuisine is a vibrant tapestry of flavors, aromas, and traditions, and at its heart lies a dish that has captivated palates worldwide: Tavuk Sis. These succulent chicken skewers, marinated to perfection and grilled until tender, represent the essence of simple yet profoundly satisfying cooking. Whether savored from a bustling Istanbul street vendor or a cozy Anatolian restaurant, the allure of Tavuk Sis is undeniable. This article guides you through preparing exquisite **Tavuk Sis Chicken Skewers** right in your own kitchen, bringing a taste of Turkey to your table.

## What is Tavuk Sis?
Tavuk Sis, pronounced 'tah-vook shish,' literally translates to 'chicken skewer.' It's a cornerstone of Turkish grilling, often enjoyed as part of a mezze spread or a standalone main course. Unlike some kebabs using ground meat, Tavuk Sis features boneless, skinless chicken chunks, typically breast or thigh, meticulously marinated in yogurt, olive oil, spices, and often tomato or pepper paste. This marinade is the secret to its incredible tenderness and rich flavor, ensuring the chicken remains juicy even when cooked over high heat. The tradition of skewering and grilling meat dates back centuries in Anatolia, making these **Tavuk Sis Chicken Skewers** a culinary heritage.
